_description: Slice 13e — the OFF-DOMAIN set: 24 questions that are genuinely nothing to do with work, HR, pay, contracts or the convenio. Spanish and colloquial (one English case: the real staging trigger). Gate expectation (spec §5.1): >= 18 of 24 `decline`; 0 escalate-with-card; 0 answers. A question may NOT sit here if a reasonable employee could be asking it about their job — those live in borderline-12.json or the never-decline set. Run as `answer:gate --engine=agent --persist` on test-gipuzkoa@example.com (one fresh session per case). FROZEN + HASHED in MANIFEST.sha256 before build; the held-out discipline is the 13b/13c one (never read a result back into this file).
_provenance: OD-01 is the real staging question that created an off_domain planner escalation (staging session, trace.agent.planner_escalation.category = off_domain). It was shown to the planner once in the plan-gate probe (anchor A1) — disclosed, it was not tuned on. OD-02 is anchor A2 in the same probe. The other 22 have never been sent to any model.
_expect_note: Every case carries an explicit `expect` (the gate reads `expect`, not a file-level default). `no_card` is NEW in 13e: AnswerGate fails the case if the turn produced an escalation card (`escalation_uuid` non-null). `outcome: decline` needs the new outcome to exist, so this set cannot be run before build step 9.
